title: Absolute tail as a complement probability
statement: Let $\nu$ be a probability measure on $\mathbb R$, and let $t\ge 0$. The measure of the set $\{x\in\mathbb R:t<|x|\}$ is one minus the measure of the interval $[-t,t]$.
hypotheses_covered: $\nu$ is a probability measure on $\mathbb R$
